title: A host whose graphyard-host-shim is older than this release takes no shards and is named in master status
description: A merge trial with one added host reached over SSH through graphyard-host-shim. When the host's shim probe reports a digest other than this release's shim and lacks a verb the trial uses (GY-3517), the host gets no shard: every shard runs on this machine with the one-host verdict, master status remoteShards lists the host away with the 'older than this release: run graphyard host prepare' reason, and an attention line names it. With the current shim the same host takes shards again.

steps.name: Run a trial with a stale-shim host, then with the current shim
